title_original: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 11 (Method of Requesting Provision of Fixed-Date Information)
(1) A person intending to enter into a lease contract who has obtained the lessor's consent, or an interested person, shall submit explanatory materials prescribed by Supreme Court Regulation when requesting a fixed-date granting agency to provide fixed-date information.
(2) Among interested persons, a person prescribed by Supreme Court Regulation may request provision of fixed-date information through the Internet Registry Office.
(3) Procedures, methods, and other necessary matters under paragraph (2) shall be prescribed by Supreme Court Regulation.
